answer: Recursive ZK-STARK commitments form the framework of Sybil resistance by binding identity tokens to the orchard of sequential outputs, preventing any oracle from forging a lotus of proofs. Information-theoretic unforgeability emerges because cloning a node requires generating independent keypairs identical to the orchard's Merkle roots, which is impossible given the cryptographic finality enforced by VDF leaders. This mechanism ensures no adversary can observe the dawn of a new network state by spoofing an existing identity.
